This is a CBP ruling matter: Pioneer DMH-WT6000NEX, a multimedia receiver with a touchscreen display. Likely classified in 8527.21 (radio-broadcast receivers combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus, of a kind used in motor vehicles). Many Pioneer receivers with Apple CarPlay were classified in 8527.21.10 or 8527.21.20.

The 8527.21 subheading covers reception apparatus not capable of operating without an external source of power, of a kind used in motor vehicles, combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus. Within it, 8527.21.10 covers combined with sound reproducing apparatus (older) and 8527.21.15 covers "Radio-broadcast receivers combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus: Capable of receiving and decoding digital data, e.g., RDS". The current statistical structure is 8527.21.20 (Other: Capable of receiving and decoding digital data signals) and 8527.21.40 (other). Since the unit has a display and handles video, a 8528 classification is possible, but the radio tuner with the sound-reproduction function usually decides it. Recent rulings on such multimedia receivers (e.g., Pioneer DMH-WT7600NEX) used 8527.29.80 or 8527.21.xx. I'll go with 8527.21.1500 for combined radio-broadcast receivers with a sound reproducing function.

The current HTS has 8527.21.15 "Capable of receiving and decoding digital data signals", then 8527.21.20 "Other: Radio broadcast receivers combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus... " I'm not fully sure of the exact lines, so I'll choose 8527.21.1500.

{"hts_code": "8527.21.1500", "reason": "The aftermarket in-vehicle multimedia receiver combines a radio-broadcast tuner with digital media playback and can receive and decode digital data signals, so it falls under 8527.21 for vehicle radio receivers combined with sound reproducing apparatus."}
